summary: Install-time exfiltration of installer identity to webhook.site OOB collector
details: cat-sis2go-utils@99.1.0 registers both preinstall and postinstall lifecycle scripts that execute scripts/run.js on npm install. That script collects the installer's OS username (from os.userInfo() and USER/USERNAME environment variables) and hostname (os.hostname()) and POSTs them as JSON to a hardcoded webhook.site collector at https://webhook.site/d22d92dc-84e5-4b58-8cd6-75bf1ac452c7, and additionally performs a DNS lookup against dnshook.site as an out-of-band canary. The implausibly high version number (99.1.0) and the automatic transmission of installer identity to an author-chosen OOB endpoint match the canonical dependency-confusion beacon pattern.
